name: Coral
rootCause: The wRAM of the EOS ecological DeFi liquidity mining project Coral was attacked by hackers and lost more than 120,000 EOS.

descriptions.text: The wRAM of the EOS ecological DeFi liquidity mining project Coral was attacked by hackers and lost more than 120,000 EOS.

Coral Finance, a DeFi project on EOS, was exploited on September 10, 2020, resulting in the draining of over 120,000 EOS, valued at approximately $420,000. The attack was enabled by a reentrancy flaw likely involving wRAM handling, with no verifiable recovery or technical postmortem published. A missing checks-effects-interactions pattern in Coral Finance's EOS smart contract allowed a reentrancy attack. The contract failed to update user balances before executing external calls, particularly involving wRAM transfers. This enabled repeated withdrawals and draining of the protocol's assets.
